audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 with 53.96% WR over 2387 games reads right: Syndra owns every laning stage on range, Qiyana's threat is the flank all-in and late assassin pick, Syndra wins honest teamfights. Content layer already carries this.
Spikes complete: levels 3-5 range dominance, level 6 R-before-her-window, Luden's one-shot, late Qiyana flank threat vs Syndra teamfight. spikes[] has all 4 entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three content fields called Qiyana's engage dash 'her Q dash'. Her dash onto an enemy is Audacity (E, 11s down to 7s); Q is Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, the weapon swing.
audit.why: Enemy kit is explicit: E 'dashes to an enemy'; Q 'swings her weapon'. Wrong slot teaches the wrong cooldown to track.
audit.corrected: whys[2], spikes[0].text and mid now say Audacity dash.

edits.before: You own the early lane: Qiyana has to walk into melee range to auto or Q you, and every step forward eats a Q or W-Q combo. Hold your E stun for her Q-dash and you flip her all-in attempt into a free trade, since her early is weak until she has element control.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you keep the whip hand — hold your QE stun for her Q dash rather than wasting it on poke, and shove her off the river so she can't pick up brush or terrain for the empowered Edge of Ixtal.
